note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: OpenAI limits new AI models to 'trusted partners' at request of U.S. government
items.blurb: GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna launched only to ~20 government-vetted partners — the access-review regime that hit Anthropic now extends to OpenAI.

items.title: OpenAI releases powerful new GPT-5.6 model under restrictions
items.blurb: Three GPT-5.6 tiers — Sol, Terra, Luna — debut in limited preview to ~20 approved firms; broad release pegged to a federal cyber framework.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic face new AI reality as users shift from 'tokenmaxxing' to efficiency
items.blurb: As IPOs near, buyers demand ROI over raw capability; some startups swap frontier Claude for cheaper open models like DeepSeek.

items.title: Nvidia, Alphabet sit out megacap tech bounce as chip stocks sink
items.blurb: SoftBank-led Asian tech selloff and AI-infrastructure cost worries keep chip names under pressure into the week's close.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Foundation back Raimondo's $500M effort to prepare workers for AI
items.blurb: 'Raise Us' will test wage insurance, retraining incentives and AI career coaching in four states as labor disruption mounts.

items.title: Micron soars 15% after blockbuster earnings, lifting chip stocks
items.blurb: Memory maker's revenue quadrupled to $41.5B on AI data-center demand, beating estimates and easing AI-bubble fears.

items.title: SK Hynix surges 12% after Micron earnings; blockbuster Nasdaq listing
items.blurb: Memory peers rallied on Micron's results as AI buildout keeps memory-chip demand and prices elevated.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Micron steals Nvidia's margin king crown
items.blurb: Surging memory prices push Micron's margins past Nvidia's, reshaping who profits most from the AI compute boom.

items.title: OpenAI and Broadcom reveal Jalapeno, first AI chip in partnership
items.blurb: First OpenAI-Broadcom co-designed chip, built in nine months, targets initial deployment by end of 2026 to ease GPU dependence.

items.title: Qualcomm inks deal for AI startup Modular to bolster software stack, data center build-out
items.blurb: Qualcomm moves to acquire Modular for nearly $4 billion, expanding its data-center software position as AI compute demand surges.

items.title: Tech stocks try to rebound after global AI sell-off batters chip companies
items.blurb: Asian tech shares partly rebounded after a global AI-driven selloff cut chip stocks; Micron slid into its after-bell earnings.

items.title: Investors may be hitting pause on the AI run-up
items.blurb: AI chip stocks pulled back amid valuation concerns, denting a months-long semiconductor rally as investors weighed returns.

items.title: Anthropic accuses Alibaba of campaign to 'brazenly' and 'illicitly' extract AI capabilities
items.blurb: Anthropic told a Senate committee Alibaba mounted the 'largest known distillation attack' on its models, escalating US-China IP tensions.

items.title: OpenAI fires up 'Jalapeño,' its first homegrown AI chip
items.blurb: Custom inference accelerator aims to cut OpenAI's reliance on Nvidia GPUs for serving ChatGPT and Codex at scale.

items.title: Tech companies would have to pay AI data center energy costs under bill moving in Congress
items.blurb: House bill would let utilities set a 'large load standard' making data-center builders pay for grid upgrades as AI power demand strains the grid.

items.title: AI groups spend $20 million in New York race shaping federal AI policy
items.blurb: AI-aligned PACs pour over $20M into a New York Democratic primary seen as a bellwether for U.S. AI regulation.

items.title: The $400 million machine powering the future of chipmaking
items.blurb: ASML's next-gen High-NA EUV lithography systems underpin the advanced chips that frontier AI training depends on.

items.title: Google takes the hit in AI's talent war
items.blurb: High-profile DeepMind and Gemini researchers leave for OpenAI and Anthropic, whose forthcoming IPOs sweeten recruiting.

items.title: Anthropic's Mythos model found vulnerabilities in classified U.S. government systems, official says
items.blurb: A U.S. official told AP that Anthropic's Mythos identified flaws in highly secure government computers during testing, sharpening the export-freeze standoff.

items.title: Tech rout intensifies as sell-off grips global stocks
items.blurb: A widening tech rout hit the Magnificent Seven and Asian chipmakers Samsung and SK Hynix, dragging the SMH chip ETF down 7%.

items.title: Google's online dominance is showing signs of cracking in AI era
items.blurb: ChatGPT use rises and DuckDuckGo installs jump as Google search traffic slips and AI researchers depart; Alphabet stock fell 5%.

items.title: SpaceX signs computing power deal with open-source AI startup Reflection worth up to $6.3 billion
items.blurb: Reflection AI to pay $150M/month from July for Nvidia GB300 capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 2, deepening the compute buildout.

items.title: Three things to watch amid Anthropic's latest feud with the government
items.blurb: Analysis of the escalating standoff after the US export order forced Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign users.

items.title: Alphabet has its worst day in over a year on AI concerns after high-profile exits
items.blurb: Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer departs for OpenAI and DeepMind's John Jumper for Anthropic, driving Alphabet's sharpest one-day drop in a year.
